verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Brewfiles can set up dependencies in CI services such as GitHub Actions, and `brew bundle check || brew bundle install` skips work when dependencies are already satisfied. These are adjacent setup and idempotency features. Nothing documents a CI cache-restore setup (for example, caching bottles or the download cache between runs) or offline-capable installs, so the axis applies but there is no evidence the product delivers it.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can make CI installs fast with a documented cache-restore setup and offline-capable installs
